turns.input: Captain Doran Hale gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Captain Doran Hale reaches down and pulls a worn pair of leather boots from his belt, extending them toward Nicco. "You'll want proper footwear if you're walking these streets," he says. His blue eyes remain steady, measuring. "West doesn't forgive soft feet."

Nicco takes the boots. The leather is scuffed but solid, clearly guard-issue or former guard-issue, broken in by someone who spent long hours standing watch.

The captain's arms fold across his heavy armor, the gesture deliberate and patient. "Half hour you've been standing there staring up at that tower." He tilts his bald head slightly, a veteran's assessment rather than accusation. "Waiting for something. Permission, maybe. Or trouble."

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
"You'll want proper footwear if you're walking these streets," Doran says. "West doesn't forgive soft feet."

The captain's brow lowers at the return offer. He doesn't reach for the boots. "I gave you those because you need them," he says. "I've got armored boots. Guard issue." He nods toward Nicco's feet. "Put them on. Walk back inside if that's where you're bound, or walk somewhere else. But don't walk barefoot in West District."
